```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
df <- readr::read_csv("/Users/reagangonzales/Documents/foodrescue/data-raw/Corrected_FRN_Collection_Form_Sep30_Nov4.csv")
library(foodrescue)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
clean_df <- clean_food2(df)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
clean_data <- clean_df[['clean_data']]
tidy_data <- clean_df[['tidy_data']]
```

This is The Smith College Food Rescue Network's biweekly report for the week of October 19th. "Last 2 weeks" is defined as dates between October 18th to November 4th. Data was pulled in November 5th.

# Lbs of food rescued last 2 weeks

```{r}
tidy_data |>
  filter(date >= '2026-10-18') |>
  pull(weight) |> 
  sum(na.rm = TRUE)
```

881.9 Ibs of food

# Total lbs of food rescued so far this semester 

```{r}
sum(tidy_data$weight)
```

1887.19 Ibs so far

# Pans collected the last 2 weeks

We don't include compass cafe and campus center cafe containers because they don't use the standard containers that the other dining halls use

```{r}
clean_data |>
  filter(date >= '2026-10-18') |>
  filter(!dining_hall %in% c("Compass Cafe", "Campus Center Cafe")) |>
  # calculate containers sums
  summarize(total_pans = sum(containers))
```

110 pans collected in last 2 weeks

# Total pans collected so far this semester 

Excluding campus cafe and compass cafe.

```{r}
clean_data |>
  filter(!dining_hall %in% c("Compass Cafe", "Campus Center Cafe")) |>
  # calculate containers sums
  summarize(total_pans = sum(containers))
```

224 pans collected so far this semester

# Most collected food/category last 2 weeks 

```{r}
tidy_data |>
  filter(date >= '2026-10-18') |>
  group_by(type) |>
  summarise(total_weight = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_weight))
```

Most collected food last 2 weeks: Rice 201 Ibs

# Summary

- 881.9 Ibs of food rescued last 2 weeks

- 1887.19 Ibs of food rescued so far this semester

- 110 pans collected last 2 weeks

- 224 pans collected so far this semester

- Rice (201 Ibs) most collected food category in the last 2 weeks
